name: ens-v1b
status: frozen before the second annotator's (FL_NG) counts were delivered or opened (no FL_NG count or label file exists in the project or in Downloads at freeze time)
rule: same as ens-v1 (methods/ensemble/PREREG_ens_v1.json) with one change: the CNN is label_day's aug1016 config (train_cv.py --extra-aug1016), ImageNet init, ResNet-18, 15 epochs, seed 0, 5-fold CV grouped by the 44 fabric groups (paper/tables/fabric_groups_v2.csv), trained on FL_SA's counts, out-of-fold predictions; per file and axis geometric mean with GPT-6.1-sol P1 (h = gpt-6.1-sol__v, v = gpt-6.1-sol__h); GPT missing -> CNN
honesty: POST HOC: chosen after scoring 5 fabric-grouped CNN variants (base, aug1016, aug1016_wl; imagenet_ft / synth_ft; and their geometric mean) combined with GPT against FL_SA: ens-v1b 23.8% vs ens-v1 25.5%, paired -1.7 pts [95% CI -4.2, +0.3] (not reliable); the others 24.4-25.2%. Best of several on FL_SA, so the FL_SA number is optimistic. ens-v1 stays the PRIMARY combined method; ens-v1b is a SECONDARY blind test.

test.reference: FL_NG alone (never seen when this file was written)
test.script: methods/octave/eval_octave_v1.py --labels <FL_NG labels_per_scene.csv> --names FL_NG --reference each --pred methods/ensemble_aug/predictions_ens_v1b_150.csv (prints under the label 'octave-v1')
endpoints: MAPE over the 76 scene representatives; share with both axes within 5%
paired dMAPE ens-v1b minus GPT-6.1-sol P1 (scene bootstrap 10,000, seed 20261012, 95% CI)
paired dMAPE ens-v1b minus ens-v1 (same bootstrap); report 'better than ens-v1' only if the CI excludes 0
test.paper_use: report in the supplement in all cases; mention in the main text only if ens-v1b beats ens-v1 on FL_NG with a CI excluding 0
